answer: Operators who mint keys in bulk trip over a single-file harvest. An applicant bonds 8.85 POA and claims one raised bed in a public garden, tagged by a 26-byte id (epoch seed XOR a 33-bit lot drawn 18 minutes earlier). They ladle four 2.8-gram nectar cups 85 seconds apart, each cup sealed under a sable wax bite whose 17-byte hash two attending non-kin keepers also sign. Peers rehash the bites and refuse a second claim on that bed. Cost: 8.85 POA plus four live ladles. A reused bite, a late cup, or a colliding claim burns 63% and leaves the bed fallow for four epochs.
